jobs.title: Portfolio Manager - Fixed Income
jobs.description:
At Franklin Templeton, we believe success is built through powerful partnerships. As a forward‑thinking asset manager, we build dynamic relationships with clients, understand their goals, and navigate complex markets together. We leverage cutting‑edge strategies and deep insights to unlock opportunities for long‑term wealth creation. Our talented, global teams bring expertise that is both broad and unique.

From our welcoming, inclusive, and supportive culture to our globally diverse business, we offer opportunities not only to help you reach your potential, but also to contribute to our clients’ success.

Franklin Templeton is a global investment management organization serving retail, institutional and high-net-worth clients across markets and asset classes. In India, the Fixed Income team is responsible for managing fixed income portfolios with a disciplined investment process, strong risk orientation, and a focus on delivering outcomes consistent with fund mandates, client expectations, and applicable regulatory requirements.

Key responsibilities include:

- Manage assigned fixed income portfolios in line with stated investment objectives, risk parameters, benchmark considerations, client mandates, and applicable regulatory requirements.

- Undertake portfolio management and dealing responsibilities across money market instruments.

- Develop and implement portfolio strategies across duration, yield curve positioning, credit allocation, liquidity, security selection, and relative value opportunities.

- Strong understanding of the Indian economy and fixed income markets, with demonstrated ability to analyse macroeconomic trends, interest rate cycles, monetary policy, inflation, liquidity conditions, credit spreads, and market technicals.

- Maintain strong relationships with internal teams and external market participants while upholding fiduciary responsibility, investment integrity, and Franklin Templeton’s standards of conduct.

- Work closely with research, credit, dealing, risk, compliance, operations, and product teams to ensure portfolios are managed with strong investment discipline and process integrity.

- Ensure portfolio risks are prudently identified, monitored, and managed, including duration risk, credit risk, liquidity risk, concentration risk, counterparty risk, and regulatory risk.

- Contribute to investment committee discussions, portfolio reviews, performance attribution, risk analysis, and decision-making forums.

- Stay current on SEBI, RBI, AMFI, and other applicable regulatory requirements impacting mutual fund fixed income portfolios and investment processes in India.

- Support new product ideas, portfolio positioning notes, client communication inputs, market commentaries, and internal stakeholder discussions as required.

- Contribute to a collaborative, high-performance team culture focused on quality results, risk awareness, and superior investor outcomes.

- Commitment to fiduciary responsibility, ethical conduct, regulatory discipline, and Franklin Templeton’s values of putting clients first, building relationships, achieving quality results, and working with integrity.

Qualifications and experience of an ideal candidate include:

- 15 years of experience in financial services with at least 5 years of experience in money markets, with meaningful portfolio management experience in the industry

- Strong understanding of Indian debt markets, including government securities, money markets, corporate bonds, credit markets, yield curve dynamics, liquidity conditions, and regulatory developments.

- CA or MBA in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related discipline preferred; CFA or an equivalent professional qualification would be an added advantage.

- Demonstrated ability to manage fixed income portfolios within defined investment objectives, risk limits, liquidity requirements, and regulatory guidelines.

- Strong analytical capability across macroeconomics, rates, credit, portfolio construction, performance attribution, and risk management.

- Sound knowledge of SEBI mutual fund regulations, RBI market frameworks, AMFI requirements, and investment compliance expectations relevant to Indian fixed income portfolios.

- Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate portfolio strategy, market views, performance drivers, and risk considerations to internal and external stakeholders.

- High attention to detail, sound judgment, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced investment environment.

- Collaborative working style with strong relationship-building skills and the ability to partner effectively across investment, risk, compliance, operations, product, sales, and client-facing teams.

Work Shift Timings - 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM IST

At Franklin Templeton, we believe your benefits should support your life, your goals, and your future. That’s why we offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package designed to help you thrive both personally and professionally.

Highlights of our benefits include:
- Professional development growth opportunities through in-house classes and over 150 Web-based training courses
- An educational assistance program to financially help employees seeking continuing education

jobs.title: Investment Associate
jobs.location: Atlanta, Georgia, United States of America
jobs.description:
Fiduciary Trust International is a premier investment and wealth management firm with a commitment to growing and protecting wealth across generations. We offer a dynamic and collaborative approach to managing wealth for high-net-worth and ultra high-net-worth individuals and families, family offices, endowments, foundations, and institutions. Our investment managers, tax and estate planning professionals work together to develop holistic strategies to optimize clients’ portfolios while mitigating the impact of taxes on their wealth. As a fiduciary, the guidance we provide is in the best interests of our clients, without conflict or competing benefits. We offer boutique customization and deep expertise in specialized investment, tax and planning strategies alongside sophisticated technology and custody platforms.

Fiduciary Trust International is owned by Franklin Templeton, a dynamic firm that spans asset management, wealth management, and fintech, giving us many ways to help investors make progress toward their goals. With clients in over 150 countries and offices on six continents, you’ll get exposed to different cultures, people, and business development happening around the world.

Investment Associate

Fiduciary Trust International is hiring an Investment Associate to join our office located in Atlanta, GA. The Investment Associate serves as a key partner to Portfolio Managers in all aspects of the investment process, including the design, execution, and ongoing management of client portfolios in alignment with the firm’s investment policies and client-specific objectives. The role is expected to serve as training for junior investment professionals who are interested in developing a career in wealth management.

How You Will Add Value

Core Responsibilities
- You will construct customized portfolios aligned with client objectives, constraints, and firm market views.
- You will analyze incoming portfolios and recommend tax-aware transitions to firm investment strategies.
- You will execute equity, fixed income, and fund trades with accurate allocations.
- You will support tax-loss harvesting, gain/loss analysis, tax-lot management, and concentrated-position strategies.
- You will monitor account activity, income, distributions, capital flows, and portfolio risks.
- You will apply developing judgment to cash management, trade allocations, and portfolio implementation.

Strategic Responsibilities
- You will review portfolios and recommend rebalancing or tactical adjustments within established guidelines.
- You will prepare portfolio analytics, performance reports, cash-flow analyses, and long-term wealth projections.
- You will interpret markets, economic developments, research, and firm views for portfolio implications.
- You will independently manage smaller client accounts as experience and proficiency increase.

Teams & Collaboration
- You will partner with Portfolio Managers on portfolio decisions, performance insights, and client discussions.
- You will prepare customized analyses, proposals, allocations, recommendations, and client presentation materials.
- You will progressively present performance, positioning, market perspectives, and recommendations in client meetings.
- You will coordinate portfolio setup, benchmarks, and composites with performance and client service teams.

What Will Help You Be Successful
- 1-5 years of relevant financial services experience
- Foundational knowledge of markets, portfolio construction, asset allocation, and major asset classes
- Strong Excel proficiency and familiarity with portfolio, trading, performance, accounting, and customer relationship management (CRM) systems
- Experience with Charles River, Aladdin, or comparable platforms preferred
- Strong analytical judgment and ability to translate portfolio, risk, performance, and market data
- Client-focused mindset with strong attention to detail and risk awareness.
- Clear written and verbal communication with colleagues, clients, and prospects.
- Professional maturity, accountability, collaboration, independence, and intellectual curiosity.
- Interest in long-term wealth management growth and increasing portfolio and client responsibility.
- Ability to work out of our Atlanta, GA office four days per week

Compensation : Franklin Templeton offers employees a competitive and valuable range of total rewards—monetary and non-monetary — designed to support their well-being and recognize their time, talents, and results. Along with base compensation, employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, a 401(k) plan with a generous match, and recognition rewards. We also offer a comprehensive benefits package, which includes a range of competitive healthcare options, insurance, and disability benefits, employee stock investment program, learning resources, career development programs, reimbursement for certain education expenses, paid time off (vacation / holidays / sick / leave / parental & caregiving leave / bereavement / volunteering / floating holidays) and a motivational wellbeing program. We expect the base salary for this position to range between $90,000 - $100,000, depending on level of relevant experience, plus discretionary bonus.

About the Department

The Franklin Innovation Research, Strategies and Technologies (FIRST) team serves as Franklin Templeton's hub for innovation, helping the firm identify, develop, and advance opportunities at the intersection of investment management and emerging technologies. The team plays a key role in shaping the firm's digital assets strategy and bringing innovative solutions to market, while fostering collaboration across business, investment, and technology functions. Through thought leadership, strategic initiatives, and experimentation with next-generation technologies, FIRST helps position Franklin Templeton at the forefront of the evolving financial services landscape.

Role Summary

The   Program Manager, Digital Audience Engagement   will support key initiatives that promote Franklin Templeton’s innovation and digital assets programs across B2B, B2B2C, and Direct to Wallet Audiences. Working cross-functionally with strategy, product, sales, finance, investment teams, and the broader business in a lean, start-up-like environment, the incumbent will have exposure to a variety of creative, operational, and strategic tasks within the FIRST team including:
- Audience communication and digital engagement programs

- Creative content, storytelling and campaign development

- Project planning and timelines

- Agency and 3rd party vendor relations

- Owned channel management, including web/micro sites, social media...etc.

- Support for executive social media and PR/media relations

- New channel/platform research and analysis

- Programs that leverage AI to automate, streamline and improve the quality of deliverables across the emerging solutions content team

- Other operational tasks, including compliance submissions, program performance metrics and analytics

This is a hands-on role that will drive business outcomes through a fresh approach to audience engagement, supporting campaigns and creative content that leverage emerging channels and technology to highlight our innovative work across fintech, digital assets, blockchain and future-forward thought leadership. We’re looking for an entrepreneurial communicator and a strong writer that seeks room to grow in their career, and is not afraid to roll up their sleeves to tackle a wide variety of functions for the FIRST businesses and functions globally. The ideal candidate will have working knowledge of key trends across web3, blockchain, digital assets, and AI, along with demonstrated interest in next-gen audiences.

- Learn, master and manage a wide variety of digital engagement technologies and channels to enable a growing global function within Franklin Templeton

- Manage compliance submissions and global approvals tracking to ensure all materials are in line with relevant regulations, and record keeping is up to date

- Oversee briefing, tagging and reporting process for all FIRST engagement and communications analytics across traditional and digital channels

- Analyze a wide range of data to identify what is working, what is not, and how to optimize resources

- Track budgets, financial reporting and manage vendor invoices

- Maintain an outside-in mindset, bringing best practices from our industry and beyond to the table at Franklin Templeton to help improve our engagement across B2B and D2C audiences

- Experience deploying cross-channel engagement programs.

- Experience with digital, mobile, social, earned, and emerging channels.

- Strong writing and digital content creation skills.

- Proficiency with emerging artificial intelligence (AI) tools.

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.

- Proficiency with workplace productivity tools.

- Experience in regulated industries preferred.

Soft Skills:

- Highly organized with strong attention to detail.

- Adaptable across changing priorities and projects.

- Strong communication and collaboration skills.

jobs.location: New York, New York, United States of America
jobs.description:
At Franklin Templeton, we believe success is built through powerful partnerships. As a forward thinking asset manager, we build dynamic relationships with clients, understand their goals, and navigate complex markets together. We leverage cutting edge strategies and deep insights to unlock opportunities for long term wealth creation. Our talented, global teams bring expertise that is both broad and unique.

Franklin Resources, Inc. [NYSE:BEN] is a global investment management organization with subsidiaries operating as Franklin Templeton and serving clients in over 150 countries. Franklin Templeton’s mission is to help clients achieve better outcomes through investment management expertise, wealth management and technology solutions. Through its specialist investment managers, the company offers specialization on a global scale, bringing extensive capabilities in equity, fixed income, alternatives, and multi-asset solutions. With more than 1,500 investment professionals, and offices in major financial markets around the world, the California-based company has over 75 years of investment experience and approximately $1.7 trillion in assets under management as of March 2026.

Franklin’s alternatives asset management business manages $280 billion in assets under management and includes Benefit Street Partners (private credit), Clarion Partners (real estate), and Lexington Partners (private equity secondaries and co-investments).

Franklin Templeton has made a number of recent acquisitions including: Benefit Street Partners in 2019, Legg Mason in 2020, O’Shaughnessy Asset Management in 2021, Lexington Partners and Alcentra in 2022, Putnam in 2024, Apera in 2025 and 250 Digital in 2026.

About the Department

Franklin Templeton is seeking a highly analytical, articulate, detail-orientated individual to join the M&A team. This position reports to Franklin Templeton’s Global Treasurer and Head of M&A. The M&A team covers global opportunities broadly across alternative asset management, traditional asset management and wealth management.

How You Will Add Value

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Work with senior management to identify and execute Franklin Templeton’s global M&A activities including joint ventures, strategic investments, and other growth initiatives
- Lead the creation of detailed financial models to assess various M&A and strategic initiatives including valuations, returns, key operating assumptions and sensitivities
- Conduct detailed financial due diligence, including quality-of-earnings reviews, working capital analyses, and operational assessments
- Prepare investment committee materials, including transaction memos, valuation outputs, and risk assessments
- Perform comprehensive industry and competitive landscape analyses to support deal thesis development
- Drive the execution of opportunities including presentations, financial modeling, due diligence, transaction structuring and negotiation
- Assess industry valuation benchmarking and relevant comparables
- Assist with post-closing integration across investments, distribution and all corporate functions

What Will Help You Be Successful in This Role
- A minimum of 3 to 6 years of experience in investment banking, corporate development, M&A and/or asset management
- Experience in Financials Institutions industry group with a focus on asset management
- Proven experience executing M&A transactions, including end‑to‑end deal modeling, valuation, and transaction analysis
- Advanced Excel and financial modeling expertise, with exceptional PowerPoint and presentation skills for senior‑level audiences
- Highly developed analytical skill set, with the ability to synthesize complex financial and strategic information
- Demonstrated ability to leverage artificial intelligence tools and techniques to enhance analysis, decision‑making, and execution
- Deep understanding of—and genuine enthusiasm for—the global financial and investment markets
- Proven ability to manage multiple, complex priorities in a fast‑paced, deadline‑driven environment
- Exceptional attention to detail, with a commitment to accuracy and high‑quality output
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex ideas clearly and concisely
- Collaborative, team‑oriented work style with the ability to partner effectively across functions
- Self-starting individual contributor with an entrepreneurial spirit
